quests.instruction: Tap the body part that helps you hear someone call your name!
quests.question: Ears
quests.hint: Hint: Your favorite song plays through these.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Ears help you hear sounds like music and voices!
quests.funFact: Did you know? the smallest bone in your entire body is inside your ear.

quests.instruction: Can you touch the body part that wears a hat when it is cold outside?
quests.question: Head
quests.hint: Your hat goes right on top of it.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Head is the part on top of your neck that holds your brain and face!
quests.funFact: Did you know? the adult human head weighs about 10 to 11 pounds.

quests.instruction: Can you touch the body part we brush every morning to make it neat?
quests.question: Hair
quests.hint: It grows longer if you do not cut it.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Hair grows on top of your head and helps keep it warm!
quests.funFact: Did you know? hair grows slightly faster in warmer weather.

quests.instruction: Tap the body part that stretches out wide when you fly like an airplane!
quests.question: Arms
quests.hint: Hint: You wave these to say goodbye.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Arms help you hug, wave, and carry things!
quests.funFact: Did you know? you can bend your arms thanks to your elbow joint.

quests.instruction: Tap the body part where your arms connect to your body!
quests.question: Shoulders
quests.hint: Hint: You lift these up when you shrug.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Shoulders are where your arms connect to your body, and help you shrug and lift!
quests.funFact: Did you know? the shoulder joint is called a ball-and-socket joint.

quests.instruction: Tap the body part you use to pick up a small button!
quests.question: Fingers
quests.hint: Hint: They are found at the end of your hands.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Fingers help you point, count, and pick up small things!
quests.funFact: Did you know? your fingers help you feel the texture of objects.

quests.instruction: Tap the body part you use to lick a melting ice cream cone!
quests.question: Tongue
quests.hint: Hint: You stick this out to taste snowflakes.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Tongue helps you taste your food and speak clearly!
quests.funFact: Did you know? just like fingerprints, everyone has a unique tongue print.

quests.instruction: Tap the body part we clap together to cheer for our friends!
quests.question: Hands
quests.hint: Hint: You wave these to say hello.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Hands help you hold, clap, and catch things!
quests.funFact: Did you know? hands are incredibly complex and allow you to grasp small tools.

quests.instruction: Tap the body part that helps you smell sweet flowers!
quests.question: Nose
quests.hint: Hint: It is found between your eyes and your mouth.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Nose helps you smell and breathe in fresh air!
quests.funFact: Did you know? mucus in your nose traps dust and germs.

quests.instruction: Tap the body part that helps you keep your balance when you stand on one foot!
quests.question: Toes
quests.hint: Hint: You use these to help you balance.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Toes help you balance and push off the ground when you walk!
quests.funFact: Did you know? your toes push off the ground to help you run faster.

quests.instruction: Tap the body part that helps you bite into a sandwich!
quests.question: Teeth
quests.hint: Hint: You use these to bite and chew your food.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Teeth help you bite and chew your food!
quests.funFact: Did you know? your teeth have roots that anchor deep into your jawbone.

quests.instruction: Tap the body part that smiles when you feel happy!
quests.question: Mouth
quests.hint: Hint: It smiles when you are happy.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Mouth helps you eat, talk, and smile!
quests.funFact: Did you know? the roof of your mouth is called the palate.

quests.instruction: Tap the body part that wears cozy socks and shoes!
quests.question: Feet
quests.hint: Hint: You have two, and you stand on them.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Feet help you stand, walk, and run!
quests.funFact: Did you know? the arches of your feet help you spring forward.

quests.instruction: Tap the body part where you might wear a cozy scarf!
quests.question: Neck
quests.hint: Hint: A scarf wraps around this part in winter.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Neck connects your head to your shoulders and lets your head turn!
quests.funFact: Did you know? muscles in your neck let you nod yes or shake your head no.

quests.instruction: Tap the body part that lets you watch your favorite cartoon!
quests.question: Eyes
quests.hint: Hint: They are found above your nose.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Eyes help you see everything around you, like colors and shapes!
quests.funFact: Did you know? the human eye can distinguish millions of different colors.

quests.instruction: Tap the body part that helps you climb up the stairs!
quests.question: Legs
quests.hint: Hint: You use these to kick a ball.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Legs help you walk, run, and jump!
quests.funFact: Did you know? leg muscles are massive and give you the power to jump.

quests.instruction: Tap the body part that can be curly, straight, short, or long!
quests.question: Hair
quests.hint: Hint: It sits right on top, above your forehead.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Hair grows on top of your head and helps keep it warm!
quests.funFact: Did you know? you lose dozens of hairs every day, and new ones grow back.

quests.instruction: Tap the body part you nod up and down to say yes!
quests.question: Head
quests.hint: Hint: You shake it side to side to say no.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Head is the part on top of your neck that holds your brain and face!
quests.funFact: Did you know? your head contains all of your major sensory organs.

quests.instruction: Point to the body part you use to carry your favorite teddy bear!
quests.question: Arms
quests.hint: Here's a clue: You have two, and you hug people with them!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Arms help you hug, wave, and carry things!
quests.funFact: Did you know? arms are connected to your body at the shoulder.

quests.instruction: Point to the body part that never stops working, even while you are asleep!
quests.question: Ears
quests.hint: Here's a clue: You have two, one on each side of your head!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Ears help you hear sounds like music and voices!
quests.funFact: Did you know? your ears continue to grow slowly your entire life.

quests.instruction: Point to the body part that wiggles when you play the piano!
quests.question: Fingers
quests.hint: Here's a clue: You have five on each hand!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Fingers help you point, count, and pick up small things!
quests.funFact: Did you know? the middle finger is usually the longest one.

quests.instruction: Point to the body part we wash with soap and water before we eat!
quests.question: Hands
quests.hint: Here's a clue: You clap these together to cheer!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Hands help you hold, clap, and catch things!
quests.funFact: Did you know? sweat glands on your hands help you grip objects better.

quests.instruction: Point to the body part you lift up high when you play airplane!
quests.question: Shoulders
quests.hint: Here's a clue: Your backpack straps rest right on these!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Shoulders are where your arms connect to your body, and help you shrug and lift!
quests.funFact: Did you know? strong shoulder muscles help you throw and lift heavy things.

quests.instruction: Point to the body part that moves around your mouth to help you speak clearly!
quests.question: Tongue
quests.hint: Here's a clue: It helps you taste sweet, sour, and salty foods!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Tongue helps you taste your food and speak clearly!
quests.funFact: Did you know? your tongue helps you chew your food and speak clearly.

quests.instruction: Point to the body part that a dentist checks to keep healthy and strong!
quests.question: Teeth
quests.hint: Here's a clue: You brush these with a toothbrush!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Teeth help you bite and chew your food!
quests.funFact: Fun fact: enamel on your teeth is the hardest substance in your body.

quests.instruction: Point to the body part we use to say hello to a friend!
quests.question: Mouth
quests.hint: Here's a clue: You open and close this to talk and eat!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Mouth helps you eat, talk, and smile!
quests.funFact: Fun fact: your mouth produces saliva which starts digesting food right away.

quests.instruction: Point to the body part that sneezes loudly when it feels tickly!
quests.question: Nose
quests.hint: Here's a clue: It sits right in the middle of your face!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Nose helps you smell and breathe in fresh air!
quests.funFact: Fun fact: your nose can remember over 50,000 different scents.

quests.instruction: Point to the body part you use to feel cool sand at the beach!
quests.question: Toes
quests.hint: Here's a clue: You have ten, and they wiggle inside your shoes!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Toes help you balance and push off the ground when you walk!
quests.funFact: Fun fact: your toes are crucial for keeping your balance when you walk.

quests.instruction: Point to the body part you stomp on the ground when you feel excited!
quests.question: Feet
quests.hint: Here's a clue: You wear shoes and socks on these!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Feet help you stand, walk, and run!
quests.funFact: Fun fact: each foot has 26 bones and over 100 muscles and ligaments.

quests.instruction: Point to the body part you close tight when you play hide and seek!
quests.question: Eyes
quests.hint: Here's a clue: You have two, and you blink them!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Eyes help you see everything around you, like colors and shapes!
quests.funFact: Fun fact: your eyes can process tens of thousands of pieces of information every second.
